mapper.sql: id, number, status, member_id, address_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, user_name, consignee, cancel_reason, rejection_reason, cancel_time, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status, delivery_time, delivery_fee
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_main (number, status, member_id, address_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, user_name, consignee, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status, delivery_fee) VALUES (#{number}, #{status}, #{memberId}, #{addressId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{userName}, #{consignee}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryFee})
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_main WHERE status IN #{s} GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM order_main FORCE INDEX(idx_report)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM order_main FORCE INDEX(idx_report)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(id) AS `count` FROM order_main FORCE INDEX(idx_report)
GROUP BY statDate ORDER BY statDate

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM order_main FORCE INDEX(idx_report)
